important_instructions: The appointment is completely temporary and on a contract basis for one year from the date of joining. No allowances other than the consolidated salary are admissible. Late applications or those submitted without proper documents or filled incompletely will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: DCPU Tirunelveli Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: The total number of vacancies notified is 2.

rows.qualification_required: A degree obtained from a recognized university in Social Work / Sociology / Psychology / General Health / Counselling in any stream (or) a post-graduate diploma in Counselling and Communication. Must have at least 1 year of work experience in government or quasi-government organizations (NGOs), with specific preference for women and those with experience in the child development sector. Must have acquired computer skills. Preference will be given to those with experience working in emergency assistance centers.

Passed 12th class or equivalent examination from a recognized board, with special communication skills. Must have work experience in emergency assistance centers. Preference will be given to those with work experience in emergency assistance centers.

faq.question: Q1. What is DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026 is an offline recruitment notification issued by the District Child Protection Unit, Tirunelveli to fill 2 temporary contract vacancies for Outreach Worker and Case Worker posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available, comprising 1 vacancy for Outreach Worker and 1 vacancy for Case Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit offline applications is 23 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Outreach Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a degree in Social Work, Sociology, Psychology, General Health, or Counselling, or a post-graduate diploma in Counselling and Communication, along with at least 1 year of experience in government or NGOs.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Case Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 12th class or an equivalent examination with special communication skills and experience in emergency assistance centers.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for DCPU Tirunelveli posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 42 years as of 01.10.2026, or up to 52 years for candidates with prior experience working in emergency assistance centers.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for DCPU Tirunelveli Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application form from www.tirunelveli.nic.in, fill it out, attach necessary documents, and send it by post or in person to the District Child Protection Officer in Tirunelveli.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for DCPU Tirunelveli posts?
faq.answer: The monthly salary is Rs. 23,000 for Outreach Worker and Rs. 18,000 for Case Worker.

faq.question: Q10. Are these permanent government jobs?
faq.answer: No, these are entirely temporary contract posts for one year, and employees have no right to claim permanent government employment.
